feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 28 November 2026 9:25am
items.description:
##Today##

Outbreaks of rain soon arriving this morning, turning heavy at times, before clearing late afternoon or early evening with clearer skies following. Fresh to strong southeast winds, veering west mid afternoon, then easing later. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Yellow coastal overtopping warning at high tide (~13:45). Heavy rain arriving late morning. Strong winds.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 4°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-15, up to 20-25 on hills


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 20-30, veering west 20-25 mid afternoon, then decreasing west or southwest 15-20 in the evening.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog until later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Largely dry to start on Sunday, but with a spell of rain for a time during the morning, then clearing to become dry with sunny spells in the afternoon. Turning cloudy again in the evening, ahead of rain arriving overnight. Fresh to strong southwest winds. Maximum temperature 11°C. Comments: Strong winds.

##Monday, 30 November 2026##

Periods of rain through much of Monday, persistent and heavy at times. Strong south or southwest winds increase strong to gale force by the morning. Maximum temperature of 13°C. Comments: Strong to gale force winds. Risk of coastal overtopping at high tide (~15:44). Heavy rain.

##Visibility##

##Comments##

Nil.


##Tuesday, 1 December 2026##

Outbreaks of rain at first on Tuesday, clearing away to leave a dry but largely cloudy afternoon. Strong to gale force south-southwest winds, veering west and easing by midday. Maximum temperature 13°C. Comments: Gales at first, strong winds until the afternoon. Risk of coastal overtopping at high tide (~04:18). Heavy rain at first.
